title: The Broken Cycle
description: The dead are rising near Willow Dale, Crossroads and outside Thornfield, and I have already lost two lay brothers who volunteered to bury them. Something in the lowest chambers of those ruins is breaking the cycle. Finish it before it costs a third.

objectives.description: Descend into Willow Dale's deepest chambers
Find the source of the undead corruption
Defeat the Undead Lord below the ruins
Cleanse the corrupted altar with Morthane's blessing
Return to the Priest of Morthane

notes: Threat: named against the audit's complaint - two lay brothers of the Dalhurst temple already died on grave duty in this incursion, giving the region-wide rising a concrete cost before the player is asked to finish it. Giver motive: this is personal loss for the priest, not abstract doctrine. Consequence: not wired.
